test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

He has been given a notice to vacate the house.

options.text: We are giving him a notice to vacate the house.
We had given him a notice to vacate the house.
We gave him a notice to vacate the house.
We have given him a notice to vacate the house.

solution:
The correct answer is '**We have given him a notice to vacate the house.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in passive voice. As per the question we have to change it into active voice.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject (objective case) + has been + past participle + *implied *by Object (subjective case) (Passive voice)
 
• Subject + have + past participle + Object (Active voice)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *He has been taken out by me. (Passive voice)*
 
• *I have taken him out. (Active voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject (objective case) of the given sentence is ‘**he**’.
 
• The object (subjective case) of the given sentence is implied - ‘by us’.
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• has been given will be changed to have given.

*Correct sentence - We have given him a notice to vacate the house.*
